tutorials.title: How to make this game radio wheel of your playlist using Claude
tutorials.trend: GTA 6 vychází 19. 11., největší launch roku (Fortune, gtaboom) – radio wheel je generický herní prvek, vlastní look, žádné logo.
steps: Ask for a glowing open-world-game radio wheel that spins between them.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make your own year-in-review recap using Claude
tutorials.trend: Za ~2 týdny vyjde Spotify Wrapped a všude se jede 'recap roku' formát; chytáme to dřív.
steps: Paste your year: trips, songs, wins.
Ask Claude for a bold animated recap, one stat per slide.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this Black Friday price-drop animation using Claude
tutorials.trend: Black Friday 27. 11. – malé značky teď hledají sale videa; přímo použitelné pro obchody.
steps: Give Claude your product and old and new price.
Ask for a falling price tag with a slam and confetti.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this dystopian name-draw intro using Claude
tutorials.trend: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping jde do kin 20. 11.; 'reaping' losování jmen je hotový meme formát (jen inspirace, žádné logo).
steps: Ask for a cinematic glass-ball name draw with ash and spotlight.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this snowy Christmas portrait of your pet using Higgsfield
tutorials.trend: Začíná sezóna vánočních AI portrétů mazlíčků (IG/TikTok), roste každým týdnem do prosince.
steps: Upload a photo of your pet.
Pick a cozy snowy Christmas scene and animate it.
Higgsfield builds it, you tweak it.
